meta.task: Which PETA images did the stage-1 gender checkpoint train on?
meta.method: 200 random CUHK images and 200 images spread over the other nine subsets (data/PETA/split_identity_all.csv, numpy seed 0). A fine-tuned ViT is close to perfect on its own training images.
meta.conclusion: 100% (confidence 0.9997) on the nine subsets against 92% (balanced 89%, confidence 0.981) on CUHK: the checkpoint behaves as if trained on the nine non-CUHK subsets (about 14,400 images) and not on CUHK. Not CUHK-only, and probably not all 19,000. Confirm with the Colab log or history.json.
